newsitem.title: USA: Energy Ventures to acquire Arrow Completion.
newsitem.headline: Energy Ventures to acquire Arrow Completion.

text.p: Energy Ventures Inc said it agreed to acquire Arrow Completion Systems from Weatherford Enterra Inc for about $21.5 million.
Arrow, which manufactures downhole packers and completion systems, reported revenues of $25 million for the 12 months ended September 30.
Arrow will be integrated into Energy Ventures existing packer business. Energy Ventures said it expects to see cost savings of about $3.5 million a year within the first year of acquisition.
The deal, which remains subject to regulatory approvals, is expected to close by the end of November.
Energy Ventures is an international oilfield equipment company.
